title: Query Logging and Performance
description: Log Prisma queries, analyze performance with EXPLAIN, and optimize queries for production.

data.text: Prisma Client can log queries and metrics to help you understand what is happening under the hood. Combined with PostgreSQL's EXPLAIN command, you can identify and fix performance bottlenecks.

data.title: Query Logging Configuration
data.content: Enable query logging in Prisma Client.

data.text: Use PostgreSQL's `EXPLAIN` command to analyze query plans. Prisma's `queryRaw` lets you run raw SQL with EXPLAIN for debugging.

data.title: EXPLAIN with Prisma
data.content: Run EXPLAIN on a generated query.

data.title: Tip
data.text: Add indexes on frequently filtered or sorted columns. Use `@@index` in your Prisma schema and generate a migration.
